+This function offers the possibility to generate series following a TVAR
from two approaches: bootstrap or simulation.
+
+When the parameter matrix is given, on can only simulate a VAR (nthresh=0)
or TVAR (nthresh=1 or 2). One can have a specification with constant
(default), trend, both or none (see arg include). Order in parameters is
include/lags (VECM) and include/lags/include/lags for TVECM, hence, a
matrix for a TVECM with 3 regimes, a const and a 2 lags would have 2 lines
and 2*(1+4) columns. The innovations can be given by the user (a matrix of
dim nxk, here n does not include the starting values!), by default it uses
a multivariate normal distribution, with covariance matrix specified by
varcov. The starting values (of dim lags x k) can be given. The user should
take care for their choice, since it is not sure that the simulated values
will cross the threshold even once.
+
+The second possibility is to bootstrap the series. This is done on a
object generated by TVECM (or VECM). A simple residual bootstrap is done.
Alternatively, one can simulate the series with the same parameter matrix
and with normal distributed residuals, corresponding to Monte-carlo
simulations. One can alternatively give only the series, and then the
function will call internally TVECM().
+
}
